source.section: Line 8 minimum tax, 3% of federal AGI over 150,000 (booklet PDF p.11 Line 8; PDF p.46 note); Schedule IN-112 Part I Line 14, Railroad Retirement (IN-112 Instructions PDF p.4 Line 14; booklet PDF p.23); Form IN-111 Lines 1-8 and 14 (booklet PDF pp.10-11), standard deduction chart and Lines 4-5e (PDF p.11), rate schedules (PDF p.46)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 40,000.00 + Railroad Retirement Tier 2 annuity (person 0) 90,000.00 + Railroad Retirement Tier 2 annuity (person 1) 50,000.00 + taxable interest 20,000.00 = 200,000.00. Federal taxable income = 200,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 165,300.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form IN-111, Married Filing Jointly: Line 1 federal AGI 200,000.00. Schedule IN-112 Part I: Line 1 all state and local obligation interest 0.00; Line 2 Vermont obligations 0.00; Line 3 = 0.00; Line 4 0.00; Line 6 total additions 0.00. Subtractions: Line 14 Railroad Retirement 140,000.00; Line 18 total subtractions 140,000.00. Line 19 net modifications = 0.00 - 140,000.00 = -140,000.00. Form IN-111 Line 2 -140,000.00; Line 3 = 200,000.00 + (-140,000.00) = 60,000.00. Line 4 standard deduction 15,300.00 + 2 x 1,250.00 age box(es) = 17,800.00 [person 0 born 1957-03-03 (65 or older: box checked), person 1 born 1959-05-05 (65 or older: box checked)]. Line 5a-5d personal exemptions 2; Line 5e 2 x 5,300.00 = 10,600.00. Line 6 = 17,800.00 + 10,600.00 = 28,400.00. Line 7 Vermont taxable income = 60,000.00 - 28,400.00 = 31,600.00. Line 8: schedule tax on 31,600.00 (Schedule Y-1, booklet p.46, merged continuous schedule): 3.35% x (31,600.00 - 0.00) = 1,058.60; the printed row (over 0, base 0.00 + 3.35% of the amount over 0) gives 1,058.60 (the rate schedule, not the table, because AGI is over 150,000). Federal AGI 200,000.00 is greater than 150,000.00, so Line 8 is the higher of 3% x (federal AGI 200,000.00 less U.S. obligations interest 0.00) = 6,000.00 and the schedule tax 1,058.60: 6,000.00. Line 9 0.00 (no Schedule IN-119 items; Credit for the Elderly or the Disabled not modelled); Line 10 6,000.00; Lines 11-13 0.00; Line 14 Vermont income tax 6,000.00.
